strings.name: Bruce Schneier
strings.summary: Schneier became known through Blowfish, the jointly designed Twofish cipher and books on cryptography. He expanded into organizational security, privacy, surveillance and technological power. His work connects algorithms, business security and public policy, explaining digital risks through books, newsletters and talks. Recent work with Nathan Sanders examines AI’s implications for democracy and governance.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Researches cryptography and security technology, advancing understanding of information security and digital-society risks through books and public discussion.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Physics undergraduate degree, University of Rochester; computer-science master’s degree, American University.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Algorithms and practical cryptography
strings.highlights.h1.text: Designed Blowfish and co-designed Twofish, an AES competition finalist.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Public discussion of digital risks
strings.highlights.h2.text: Examines privacy, surveillance, security institutions and AI governance through books and commentary.
strings.timeline.t1.title: DEF CON 34 address
strings.timeline.t1.text: Spoke at the Las Vegas conference; related security analysis was published in November.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Co-authors Rewiring Democracy
strings.timeline.t2.text: Published with Nathan Sanders on AI’s effects on politics, government and citizenship.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Publishes A Hacker’s Mind
strings.timeline.t3.text: Extended the idea of hacking rules to social institutions and power.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Publishes Data and Goliath
strings.timeline.t4.text: Examined government and corporate data collection, surveillance and privacy.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Co-introduces Twofish
strings.timeline.t5.text: Published the block cipher with collaborators and submitted it to the AES selection process.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Second edition of cryptography book
strings.timeline.t6.text: The second edition of Applied Cryptography surveyed algorithms, protocols and implementation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Designs Blowfish
strings.timeline.t7.text: Introduced the Blowfish block cipher for open use and research.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes physics degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned his Rochester physics degree before moving into computer science.
